name: task-check
title: Task check
description: The tick of a task row in the task tool scenario (D-65): a rounded square in the list's hue, the check drawn as a stroke. Installed by name, not through core.
docs: Render it inside a region with data-scenario="task": it reads the --task-* tokens, which exist nowhere else. Props: checked, onCheckedChange(checked), hue (day, business, ideas or dev) and aria-label (the task's title). The row, not the box, is the hit area: the check is the row's Tab stop and Space ticks it. See DESIGN.md "Scenarios".
